scope: A fire attack by Good Order squads, half-squads, and heroes of the reviewed Scenario A1 catalog, with their inherent FP and the MGs they possess, in one Location or across ADJACENT Locations, optionally directed by leaders: in the PFPh or AFPh by the phasing side, in the DFPh by the other side (including Final Fire by First-Fire-marked units), and in the MPh as Defensive First Fire, Subsequent First Fire, FPF, or a Residual FP attack; against another Location holding Personnel of the catalog, hidden units, or Dummies, with the LOS of unit step 16.

visualReadings.part: opening, printed beside the page 58 illustration
visualReadings.reading: Pinning (7.305) also occurs whenever any unit is attacked resulting in an IFT MC that is passed by rolling the highest DR possible that still results in a passed MC.

rulings.concealment: a12.14-and-a7.23-prose-admitted; hidden-units-attacked-as-concealed-A12.3-and-placed-without-concealment-when-revealed-A12.31; dummies-removed-on-ptc-or-worse-in-los-of-the-good-order-firer-A12.14; mixed-known-and-concealed-targets-one-dr-each-on-its-own-column-A12.13; concealment-table-unregistered (steps 17 and 21, R21.1 to R21.5)
rulings.fireGroups: locations-each-adjacent-to-another-A7.5; any-blocked-member-refuses-the-attack; worst-hindrance-once; tem-once; every-member-at-the-targets-level; direction-only-with-a-directing-leader-in-every-location-the-worst-leadership-applies (R20.2, R20.4 to R20.6)

resolution.firepower: Each firer's printed FP, doubled for PBF when the target is adjacent at the same level (A7.21), halved beyond Normal Range up to twice it (A7.22), halved when the target Location holds a concealed unit (A7.23), and halved when the firer is pinned (A7.8); fractions are kept and summed (A7.2).
resolution.column: The rightmost IFT column whose FP does not exceed the total (A7.3); a total below 1 has no column and no effect.
resolution.cowering: Original doubles without a directing leader shift one column left, two if any firer is Green or Conscript; below the 1 column the attack has no effect (A7.9).

drm.hindrance: the LOS read's hindrance DRM, same level only (A6.7)
drm.leadership: the directing leader's leadership modifier (A7.531, A10.7)

resolution.finalDr: Original DR plus every DRM (A.17); a Final DR at or below 0, or at or above 15, uses the end row.
resolution.effects: All target units are affected (A7.4). #KIA eliminates the # units with the highest Random Selection dr, ties at the cut included, and breaks the rest, Casualty Reducing any that cannot break (A7.301). K/# Casualty Reduces the unit with the highest dr, ties included, and every other unit takes a #MC (A7.302). NMC and #MC: one DR per unit, leaders first by Morale Level, with the leadership DRM of one unbroken leader of the Location other than the checker (A10.2, A10.21, A10.22); a Final DR above the Morale Level fails: an unbroken unit breaks, a broken unit is Casualty Reduced (A10.3); an Original 12 is a Casualty MC (A10.31); an unbroken unit passing with a Final DR equal to its Morale Level is pinned (A7.8). PTC: each unbroken, unpinned unit takes a NTC and is pinned on failure (A7.305). Then LLMC and LLTC for leader losses (A10.2). A failed MC by an unbroken unit beyond its side's declared ELR Replaces it with the broken unit of lesser quality, or Disrupts it when none exists (A19.12, A19.13); a Casualty MC beyond ELR Reduces a squad to a broken HS of lesser quality, a Conscript squad to its own HS, Disrupted. Casualty Reduction wounds a leader, with a Wound Severity dr: 5 or more, +1 if already wounded, is mortal (A17.11); a wounded leader's Morale Level is one lower and his leadership modifier one worse, which A10.72 does not let his side decline (A17.3).
resolution.concealment: A concealed target unit loses '?' on a PTC or worse result; a concealed firer or directing leader loses '?' when a Good Order target unit is within 16 hexes (A12.14).
resolution.fireCounters: Every firer and the directing leader are marked with a Prep Fire counter in the PFPh and a Final Fire counter in the DFPh (A3.2, A3.4, A7.531).
resolution.advancingFire: In the AFPh each firer's Small Arms and MG FP is halved (A7.24); an underlined squad adds one FP to its inherent FP after every other modification, rounded up, except at Long Range (A7.36).
resolution.fireGroups: A group may span Locations each ADJACENT to another of them (A7.5, A.8); each firer's PBF and Long Range are its own (A7.21, A7.22); the worst Hindrance applies to all (A7.52); leadership applies only with a directing leader in every Location, the worst of them (A7.531).
resolution.movementFire: Defensive First Fire attacks the moving stack in the Location where it spent MF (A8.1, A8.12), with -1 FFNAM unless it Assault Moved and -1 FFMO in Open Ground without Hindrance (A4.6, A4.61, A8.13); Subsequent First Fire (A8.3) and FPF (A8.31) are Area Fire; after FPF the Original DR is a NMC for each FPF firer, a Casualty MC falling on one of two or more by Random Selection (A8.31); a First-Fire-marked unit fires again in the DFPh only at an adjacent target, as Area Fire (A8.4).
resolution.residualFp: Defensive First Fire, Subsequent First Fire, and FPF leave the highest Residual FP counter at most half the highest column used, up to 12 (A8.2, A7.372), one counter lower for each point of Hindrance or positive leadership (A8.26); a Residual FP attack is alone, never halved, and not subject to Cowering (A8.22).
resolution.supportWeapons: Each MG adds its FP, with PBF, Long Range, Area Fire, and AFPh halving but not the pinned firer's halving (A7.8, A9.1); a squad keeps its inherent FP with one SW and loses it with two, a HS loses it with any (A7.351, A7.352); an Original DR at least a MG's B# (lowered by 2 for Sustained Fire, A9.3) malfunctions it, Random Selection choosing among two or more (A9.7, A9.71); a first die at most its ROF keeps its Multiple ROF unless it malfunctioned or used Sustained Fire (A9.2).
resolution.concealmentTypes: Concealed, hidden (A12.3), and Dummy targets are attacked on the halved column of A12.13 with the same DR as known targets; a PTC or worse result removes a Dummy and costs the others their "?" (A12.14, A12.31).
resolution.heatOfBattle: An Original MC DR of 2 (MC, LLMC, or an FPF firer's NMC) calls for a Heat of Battle DR with -1 elite, -1 NKVD, +1 broken (before the MC or by it), +1 Inexperienced, and the nationality DRM (A15.1, A25.25): a Final DR of 6 or less creates a hero of the unit's nationality, or makes a leader heroic, rallying him (A15.21); 5 to 8 Battle Hardens the unit (A15.3, A10.8, A25.25; ruling R28.7); 9 to 11, or 12 or more for a Fanatic unit, makes it berserk, rallied, unpinned, and without "?", unless no Known enemy unit is in its LOS, when it is Battle Hardened instead (A15.4, A15.42, A15.44); 12 or more breaks and Disrupts it, and it surrenders to one of its ADJACENT captors, if any (A15.5). A leader who goes berserk takes the other friendly units of his Location with him on a passed NTC with his leadership DRM (A15.41). A berserk target has Morale Level 10 (11 if Fanatic), is Casualty Reduced by a failed MC, eliminated by an Original 12 (a berserk leader is wounded as if already wounded, A10.31), and is never pinned (A15.42). A captor the attack leaves broken, pinned, berserk, or eliminated is no captor.
resolution.heroes: A hero adds his FP, 1 or wounded 1 at his Normal Range of 4 or wounded 3, and each hero firing within it lowers the DR by one (A15.24); a group Cowers unless every member is a hero or Fanatic (A15.2, A10.8); a hero or heroic leader who fails a MC is wounded with a Wound Severity dr, +1 on a Casualty MC, and eliminated if already wounded (A15.2, A15.21, A17.11, A10.31); he takes no PTC or LLTC, a KIA that would break him Casualty Reduces him instead (A7.301), and his Morale Level never exceeds 10, or 9 if wounded (A15.2).
resolution.ordnanceHits: An ordnance hit is resolved like any attack on the target units, from the Gun's HE FP column, with no firer counters: the Ordnance package marks the Gun (C2.24).
resolution.vehicles: After the Personnel targets, each vehicle in the target Location: its Vehicle line result or its crew's Collateral Attack, asking for an Unlikely Kill dr or the crew's MC or NTC when reached.
resolution.vehicleFire: A vehicle's MG attack reports the vehicle as its firer, with its malfunction and Multiple ROF as a weapon effect, and marks the vehicle with the phase's fire counter.

cases.reason: A declared attack inside the reviewed scope, with every roll it needs recorded, resolves to its FP column (a second one for the concealed targets of a mixed Location), DRM, Final DR, IFT result, the effect on each target unit, each MG's malfunction and Multiple ROF, the FPF firers' NMC, and the Residual FP it leaves.

Only the PFPh by the phasing side and the DFPh by the other side are reviewed; Defensive First Fire, Final Fire, Subsequent First Fire, Residual FP, and the AFPh are not. A unit that already fired this Player Turn may not fire again (A7.1).

Every firer must be a Good Order squad or half-squad of the reviewed catalog in the one firing Location, using its inherent FP and no SW, and the fire group must hold every unit of that Location firing at this target this phase; a directing leader must be unbroken, not pinned, in that Location, and not yet have directed this Player Turn. Multi-Location fire groups, SW, MG, and fire by SMC are not reviewed.

The target Location must be another Location holding only Personnel of the reviewed catalog, in terrain whose TEM the chart supplement admits (Open Ground, brush, woods, orchard, grain, wooden or stone building). Fire in the firers' own Location (TPBF) and vehicles are not reviewed.
A firer beyond twice its Normal Range cannot attack, and every member of the fire group must trace a LOS to the target; a blocked LOS allows no attack.
A weapon that is not a MG of the firer's side in the catalog, is malfunctioned or already marked, or exceeds what the firer may fire.

Subsequent First Fire beyond Normal Range or the closest armed Known enemy, FPF not at an ADJACENT unit or directed, Final Fire by a First-Fire-marked unit beyond an adjacent hex, or a Residual FP attack with firers or an unreviewed value.
One attack on a moving stack mixing pinned and unpinned units would need two DRM.
A vehicle’s MG at another level is not reviewed; Infantry fire at another level is decided with the map read’s LOS and Hindrance (ruling R10.4).
The Hindrance DRM comes from the LOS read; a count the read cannot attribute, or grain in the LOS without a declared month from June to September, is not decided.
A MC failed by an unbroken unit is decided only when its side's ELR is declared; A19.13's exception for an underscored Morale Factor is not reviewed.
With more than one leader in the target Location the owner chooses the leadership DRM and leader losses can chain.
A Heat of Battle DR the unit could take needs a fact or a counter the attack does not supply: whether a Green or Conscript unit is Inexperienced, or a unit of the next higher quality.
A roll the attack needs (the IFT DR, a Random Selection dr, or a MC, NTC, LLMC, or LLTC DR) is not recorded.
An unarmored vehicle in the target Location takes the attack's Original IFT DR with the attack's own DRM on the Vehicle line of its column.
An open-topped AFV is unharmed by small arms, and its Vulnerable CE crew takes a General Collateral Attack with the +2 CE DRM.
A vehicle's MA AAMG fires on the IFT with its own FP modifications, no Cowering, and its own breakdown and Multiple ROF.

More than one vehicle, a vehicle hit by Residual FP or an ordnance hit, an AFV in terrain with a positive TEM, Infantry sharing a Location with an AFV, or a vehicle that may not fire (in Motion in the PFPh) is outside the reviewed cases.
A CX firer or directing leader adds one to the attack's IFT DR, once however many CX units take part (ruling R5.2).
A second Original MC DR of 2 in one attack, the LLMC after the MC, calls for a second Heat of Battle DR under its own roll key while the unit is still subject to it (ruling R5.10).

With the owners' answers declared, a Battle Hardening that would change the unit and the Unlikely Kill dr after an Original 2 wait for them; a refused Battle Hardening leaves the unit's counter and Fanaticism as they were, and a declined dr leaves the Original 2's own result (rulings R5.8, R5.9).
A unit whose side is faced with No Quarter treats a Heat of Battle Surrender as Berserk and is not Disrupted (ruling R5.6).
Infantry in a Location with a wreck or a friendly AFV take its +1 TEM where their terrain gives none, and no FFMO; an attack from within the Location takes none (ruling R6.1).
Residual FP attacks a truck on the Vehicle line of its column, and an AFV's Vulnerable crew Collaterally; the target Location's SMOKE applies to it (ruling R6.6).
A concealed vehicle is attacked on the column of the halved FP (ruling R6.7).

A vehicle's AAMG fires in the MPh as Defensive First Fire, or during its own MPh as Bounding First Fire, halved for Bounding Fire and again while Non-Stopped, which leaves a Bounding Fire counter (ruling R6.9).
A closed-topped AFV is unharmed by small arms; its crew is Vulnerable only while CE, and then takes a General Collateral Attack with the +2 CE DRM (ruling R7.11).
Fire at a Gun's crew alone in its Location takes its gunshield or Emplacement +2 instead of a lower TEM; a crew with other units is outside (ruling R8.3).
A crew fires its inherent FP unless it fired its Gun this Player Turn (ruling R8.4).
A mortar's Area Target Type hit attacks at half the HE FP with the TEM on the Effects DR, woods -1 for Air Bursts (ruling R9.3).
An ATR adds 1 FP to the fire of its unit at Personnel within 12 hexes and leaves no Residual FP (ruling R9.10).
A wall or hedge TEM the game decides replaces a lower in-hex TEM, negates FFMO, and lowers the Residual FP left (rulings R10.5, R10.6).
Infantry fire at another level is resolved with the LOS and Hindrance the map read gives, and PBF at an adjacent target at most one level above (ruling R10.4).
A target above every firer with no other positive TEM takes +1 for Height Advantage and no FFMO (B10.31, p. 125, read from the rendered page; ruling R10.4).
A Snap Shot is Area Fire with no TEM, FFMO, or FFNAM (ruling R10.13).
Fire at the enemy units of the firer’s own Location is tripled as TPBF (ruling R10.14).
Hazardous Movement is -2 to an attack on the unpinned movers, with no FFMO or FFNAM (ruling R10.8).
Marsh has no TEM but no FFMO; rubble has its building’s TEM (ruling R10.1).

An OVR of the enemy-occupied Location a vehicle entered is Bounding First Fire at its OVR FP, with FFMO in Open Ground and the Location's TEM, and an Original 12 malfunctions one weapon (ruling R11.11).
An OVR is refused outside the vehicle's own Location, against an AFV, or with another kind of attack (ruling R11.11).
Opportunity Fire in the AFPh is not halved, and its MG keeps Multiple ROF (ruling R12.1).
Fire at a blocked LOS marks its firers and affects nothing (ruling R12.2).
Directed and mixed FPF, and a mixed stack of pinned and unpinned movers on one DR (ruling R12.3).
A leader's MG, alone as Area Fire or with a partner at full FP, and a squad's MG alone (ruling R12.4).
Spraying Fire at two Locations sharing a hexside on one Original DR (ruling R12.6).
A Fire Lane's Residual FP attack (ruling R12.7).
Fire into a Melee or at prisoners attacks every unit there (rulings R12.8, R12.9).
Encircled units' Morale Level and fire (ruling R12.11).
A captured MG fires with its B# two lower and its Multiple ROF one lower (ruling R13.7).
A FT attacks alone at 24 FP, or 12 at Long Range, with no TEM or leadership, and a unit possessing one takes the DR one lower (ruling R15.1).
A FT with another firer, weapon, inherent FP, or leader, by a pinned unit, or at Long Range through a Hindrance is outside the scope (ruling R15.1).
A DC attacks at 30 FP with the Location's TEM, +2 Thrown and +3 at its thrower, and is removed on its malfunction DR (rulings R15.2, R15.3).
A passed MOL Check adds four FP after every modification, and a colored 6 breaks its user (ruling R15.4).
A Commissar raises his Location's morale, checks first, and takes no LLMC (ruling R15.6).
A leader directing Allied Troops of another nationality is one worse (ruling R15.8).
An underscored squad failing beyond its ELR becomes two broken HS, an underscored HS is Disrupted (ruling R15.9).
A hero fires a MG at full FP with +1 and his heroic -1 (ruling R15.11).
Night and weather add a Low Visibility DRM that keeps FFMO and Residual FP (rulings R16.3, R16.11).
Fire at a Gunflash beyond NVR is Area Fire, halved once (ruling R16.2).
Mud or Deep Snow cushions HE in Open Ground (rulings R16.12, R16.13).
Extreme Winter lowers the B# and X# of every weapon but a DC (ruling R16.14).

admissionRule: A declared attack is resolved only when every fact is within the reviewed scope and every roll it needs is recorded; otherwise it is Abstained or Indeterminate with its reasons.
excludedConsequences: Bypass LOS to vertices (A4.34), fire between levels of one hex (B23.26), a Snap Shot across a wall or hedge hexside, bocage and Hillside walls, fire from a marsh hex (B16.32), and a vehicle’s MG fire at another level

Opportunity Fire by ordnance, mortars, and LATW, Spraying Fire in the MPh or at upper levels, and Fire Lanes along an Alternate Hex Grain, their Snap Shots, and their TPBF cancellation (A7.25, A9.5, A9.221, A9.223)
FPF by a SMC with a MG already marked First Fire (A8.312)

ordnance fire of its own (ordnance hits come from the Ordnance package), the PSK against Personnel, FT, DC, and MOL against AFVs, Flame creation (B25.12, B25.13), a Set DC (A23.7), and a DC Thrown to another level
a hero's use of a LATW, mortar, or Gun, and A7.353's halved inherent FP of a crew
captured ordnance, mortars, LATW, Guns, and vehicles (A21.13, A21.2), and the German dm MMG firing as a LMG (A9.8)
Encirclement at upper levels (A7.72), by ordnance, and of Vulnerable PRC, and its capture effects (A20.21)
the Concealment Table for vehicles, Guns, and Dummy stacks

Sniper Checks, a Sniper's repositioning, and Sniper attacks on vehicles, Snipers, and Interior Building Locations (A14.2, A14.31, A14.4), ordnance SMOKE and WP, Dispersed SMOKE and drift, Fog, Winter Camouflage, and the Clear weather within one building (E3.31, E3.712, E3.8)
any use by a game action
a hero using a LATW, mortar, or Gun (A15.23)
prisoners exchanged for Unarmed counters (A20.5), and prisoner escape (A20.55)
a crew sharing its Location with other units as a target, and Random SW Destruction of Guns by fire (C11.51, A9.74)
vehicles as targets of ordnance, more than one vehicle in a Location, and vehicles in terrain with a TEM (R25.3)
Passengers and Riders (D6), Armored Assault (D9.31), and Spreading Fire from a burning wreck (B25)
BMG and CMG, Passengers' and Riders' fire (D6.64), and a vehicle's Final Fire after its First Fire (A8.4)
An OVR with Passengers or Riders, by an Armor Leader, with a towed Gun, or of a Location holding a Gun, and OVR Reaction Fire other than CC (D7.16, D7.22)
